title: AllpassChain - 4-stage coprime Schroeder allpasses, per-voice distinct coprime delays, g=0.6, sample-rate-scaled stage times
description:
Implement Source/DSP/AllpassChain.h and Source/DSP/AllpassChain.cpp — per-voice 4-stage first-order Schroeder allpass diffusion per ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §4.5A.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §4.5A (equation, g≈0.6, coprime M tables), §7–8
- Source/DSP/DelayLineFrac.h (prepare/reset/processSample patterns)

Implement class AllpassChain:
1. N_ap = 4 cascaded stages: y = -g*x + x_delayed + g*y_delayed with g default 0.6f.
2. Per-voice table of mutually coprime stage delays at 48 kHz reference (spec example):
   - V1: {13, 29, 47, 71}
   - V2: {17, 37, 53, 79}
   - V3: {19, 41, 59, 83}
   - V4: {23, 43, 61, 89}
   Scale M by sampleRate/48000 so absolute stage times stay consistent; round to >=1 integers; keep stages mutually coprime-ish after scaling when practical (at minimum distinct per voice and non-zero).
3. setVoiceIndex(0..3) selects the table; prepare(sampleRate [, maxBlock]) allocates fixed per-stage circular buffers sized for worst-case SR scaling (no alloc in process).
4. processSample(float x) noexcept runs all 4 stages in series; optional block process().
5. reset() clears delay memory to 0. Magnitude-flat design — do not add shelf/gain EQ here.
6. Total group delay remains small (few ms); no slapback intentionally.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: AllpassChain implements N_ap=4 cascaded first-order Schroeder allpasses with default g approximately 0.6
Per-voice delay tables match V1={13,29,47,71} V2={17,37,53,79} V3={19,41,59,83} V4={23,43,61,89} at 48 kHz reference
Stage delays scale with sampleRate/48000 in prepare
prepare allocates stage buffers; processSample/reset allocate nothing and are audio-thread safe
setVoiceIndex or equivalent selects distinct per-voice delay sets
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add FFT-based decorrelator or reverb tank

allowed: fixed-size HeapBlock or std::array ring buffers allocated in prepare
integer delay lines (no fractional allpass required)
forbidden: share identical M across all voices
